info.name: User Management APIs
info.description:
Complete API suite with edge cases. Run order:
1. Folder 1: 'Login - Admin' (edit email/password; this user needs the 'Super Admin' profile).
2. Folder 2: creates Developer / Manager / Team Leader users (ids saved automatically).
3. Folder 1: run the 3 role logins (manager_token, team_leader_token, developer_token).
4. Run folders 3 to 10 in order (use 'Run folder' or run the whole collection).
Ids (client_id, project_id, task_id...) are saved automatically. Titles/emails use {{$timestamp}} so re-runs work.
Throttle: 60/min anonymous, 300/min logged-in. If the Collection Runner hits 429, raise DEFAULT_THROTTLE_RATES temporarily.
File uploads: tick the disabled file rows and pick a real file.
Swagger docs: http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/docs/
